description: This file contains helper functions and constants for handling schema compatibility, especially for 'gemini' tools, including schema cleaning, keyword filtering, and schema normalization/inspection.

methods.name: stripUnsupportedSchemaKeywords
methods.description: Recursively removes unsupported keywords from a schema object based on a set of keywords.

methods.name: stripXaiUnsupportedKeywords
methods.description: Removes XAI-specific unsupported keywords from a schema.

methods.name: resolveXaiModelCompatPatch
methods.description: Creates a ModelCompatConfig object for XAI model compatibility patching.

methods.name: applyXaiModelCompat
methods.description: Applies XAI model compatibility patch to a given model.

methods.name: findUnsupportedSchemaKeywords
methods.description: Finds and returns list of unsupported schema keywords violations within a schema.

methods.name: normalizeGeminiToolSchemas
methods.description: Normalizes tool schemas for Gemini tools using a cleaning function.

methods.name: inspectGeminiToolSchemas
methods.description: Inspects Gemini tool schemas for unsupported keywords and returns diagnostics.

methods.name: buildProviderToolCompatFamilyHooks
methods.description: Builds hooks for a given provider tool compatibility family, e.g., 'gemini'.
